summary: Frontend-only regression test of the Agora UI restyle (Vite+React) at the preview URL. Verified: app boot, Join modal ('Join the Office') + join flow, main workspace shell (AGORA logo, run-swarm/swarm-bench/manage-teams pills, action-log-panel, inspector-panel, kanban-panel with 4 columns + hatched Empty placeholders), Activity/Technical log tab switching, Initialize Swarm Run modal (disabled/enabled Execute state, Cancel closes), Swarm Benchmark Harness modal, Office 3D <-> Obsidian Graph tab toggling (graph renders nodes on warm paper), Manage Teams visual configurator (all 5 agent nodes, teams list, CREATE NEW TEAM, X closes back to workspace), Negotiation Arena open/close, BYOK modal open/close, players hover popover (shows 'QA Tester'), fullscreen + info icon buttons. No functional regressions found. No page errors; only the expected WebGPU-unavailable console error in headless Chromium. No horizontal/vertical overflow at 1920x800 (scrollW==clientW, scrollH==clientH).

issues: 'API KEY' label, input placeholder ('Paste your sk-... key here') and 'GET A QWEN CLOUD KEY' link render as very pale beige on white - contrast well below WCAG AA
Disabled SAVE button text is near-invisible (light grey on light grey)
Subtitle 'Agents debate - a Referee resolves or escalates' and footer 'Requires a Qwen Cloud (DashScope) key' are extremely low contrast
Agent name pill 'Creative Direc' is clipped/truncated without ellipsis
Empty-state text 'NO TECHNICAL DATA...' / 'AWAITING ACTIONS...' uses zinc-300 on white - hard to read
Version text 'v0.1.0' and info icon use zinc-300/zinc-400 on cream - low contrast
Default active log tab is 'Technical' (ActionLogPanel.tsx:331) rather than the user-facing 'Activity' tab - looks like a pre-existing default, worth confirming it is intentional

action_items: Improve text contrast in BYOK modal (labels, placeholder, external link, disabled Save) and Negotiation Arena (subtitle/footer) - currently pale beige on white
Fix truncated agent-name pill in Negotiation Arena ('Creative Direc') - allow wrapping or add truncate with tooltip
Add data-testid to header icon buttons (fullscreen, negotiation/scale, BYOK key, info, players counter) - currently only reachable via title attributes
Optional: consider Escape-key close for modals (brief, BYOK, Negotiation) - Escape currently does nothing; overlay/X clicks work
Optional: confirm ActionLogPanel default tab should be 'Technical' instead of 'Activity'
critical_code_review_comments: Header.tsx icon buttons (lines 157-180) and the players popover trigger lack data-testid, so automated tests must rely on title attributes - brittle.
ActionLogPanel.tsx is ~500+ lines with multiple sub-components; consider splitting log entry renderers into separate modules.
Modals (Header brief modal, BYOK, NegotiationArena) implement their own overlay/close logic with no shared Escape/focus-trap handling - duplicate pattern across files.
